## What

The first revalidation pass over `research/registers/spec-debt.md` —
the RK-06 mitigation that ADR-0198 created and BL-40 tracked: 216 active
`AssumptionDebtRecord`s generated at Phase 5 (2026-09-11) had never been
re-reviewed. Every record now carries a dated in-cell first-sweep grade;
the register gains a Log row and a `## Revalidation sweep 1` summary
block (date, method, per-trigger reads, counts, gate-rule re-check).

**Trigger reads (2026-09-11 → 2026-10-10):** T1/T2 quiet (Source
Registry unchanged since the Phase-4 fold); T3 no fired instance;
T4 fired-and-answered on every citing dependant (the eleven round-2
amendments + ADR-0050's amendment log are vocabulary rulings /
measurement appends / the resolutions the dependants anticipated); T5
quiet (all eight C4 rows carry the trigger as their standing clause).

**Grading rule** (stated in the summary block): `confirmed` only where
every pending conditional clause of (d) is an in-build deliverable that
demonstrably landed (artifact named); `still-valid-interim` where any
conditional leg is external-standing or owed to a named open
question/deferred window; `fired-unanswered` where landed state
contradicts a recorded (d) assumption with no answering artifact; and
`superseded-by-*` where a superseding ADR retired the decision.
